```{r}
###########################################################################
###########################################################################
###                                                                     ###
###                            FIGURE S2.1 AB                           ###
###                                                                     ###
###########################################################################
###########################################################################

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Tumor group mapping
# --------------------------------------------------
tumor_group_map <- c(
  "Gyn" = "UCEC.MSI", "Gyn" = "UCEC.MSS", "Gyn" = "OV",
  "Squamous" = "CESC", "Squamous" = "LUSC", "Squamous" = "HNSC.HPVneg", "Squamous" = "ESCA.SC", "Squamous" = "BLCA",
  "Adeno" = "BRCA.pos", "Adeno" = "BRCA.neg", "Adeno" = "PRAD", "Adeno" = "LUAD", "Adeno" = "LIHC",
  "GI" = "COADREAD.MSI", "GI" = "COADREAD.MSS", "GI" = "ESCA.AD", "GI" = "STAD", "GI" = "PAAD",
  "Kidney" = "KICH", "Kidney" = "KIRC", "Kidney" = "KIRP",
  "NC-Derived" = "GBM", "NC-Derived" = "LGG", "NC-Derived" = "SKCM", "NC-Derived" = "UVM",
  "Other" = "ACC", "Other" = "MESO", "Other" = "PCPG", "Other" = "SARC", "Other" = "TGCT", "Other" = "UCS"
)

##################################################
## global settings
##################################################
legend_pos   <- c(0.77, 0.85)
arm_limit_y  <- c(0, 12)
cyto_limit_y <- c(0, 300)

##################################################
## arm-level input
##################################################
arm_hit <- read.csv("./input/linear_regression_Outputs_armlvl.csv", row.names = 1)

arm_hit <- arm_hit %>%
  group_by(TumorType) %>%
  mutate(BH = p.adjust(P_val, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

arm_hit$hit_value <- arm_hit$cnv_status * arm_hit$X.signedlog.P.adj.
arm_hit$hit_group <- ifelse(arm_hit$hit_value > 0, "hot", "cold")
arm_hit$EventType <- ifelse(arm_hit$cnv_status > 0, "Gain", "Loss")

arm_hit$tumor_group <- unlist(
  sapply(arm_hit$TumorType, function(x) {
    res <- names(tumor_group_map)[tumor_group_map == x]
    if (length(res) == 0) {
      res <- "not in group"
    }
    return(res)
  })
)

arm_hit <- arm_hit[arm_hit$tumor_group != "not in group", ]
arm_hit$tumor_group <- factor(arm_hit$tumor_group)
arm_hit <- arm_hit[arm_hit$BH < 0.2, ]

##################################################
## cytoband-level input
##################################################
cyto_hit <- read.csv("input/linear_regression_Outputs_cytobandlvl.csv", row.names = 1)

cyto_hit <- cyto_hit %>%
  group_by(TumorType) %>%
  mutate(BH = p.adjust(P_val, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

cyto_hit$hit_value <- cyto_hit$cnv_status * cyto_hit$X.signedlog.P.adj.
cyto_hit$hit_group <- ifelse(cyto_hit$hit_value > 0, "hot", "cold")
cyto_hit$EventType <- ifelse(cyto_hit$cnv_status > 0, "Gain", "Loss")

cyto_hit$tumor_group <- unlist(
  sapply(cyto_hit$TumorType, function(x) {
    res <- names(tumor_group_map)[tumor_group_map == x]
    if (length(res) == 0) {
      res <- "not in group"
    }
    return(res)
  })
)

cyto_hit <- cyto_hit[cyto_hit$tumor_group != "not in group", ]
cyto_hit$tumor_group <- factor(cyto_hit$tumor_group)
cyto_hit <- cyto_hit[cyto_hit$BH < 0.2, ]

##################################################
## helper plotting function
##################################################
MakeSpecialBarplot <- function(
    df,
    arm_col = "Arm",
    special_gain = "Arm1q",
    special_loss = "Arm9p",
    title = "",
    ylim_use = c(0, 10),
    ylab_use = "Number of SCNAs") {
  ##################################################
  ## define subgroup colors
  ##################################################
  df$EventSub <- "Other"
  df$EventSub[
    df$EventType == "Gain" &
      df[[arm_col]] == special_gain
  ] <- "1q Gain"
  df$EventSub[
    df$EventType == "Loss" &
      df[[arm_col]] == special_loss
  ] <- "9p Loss"
  df$EventSub[
    df$EventType == "Gain" &
      df$EventSub == "Other"
  ] <- "Other Gain"
  df$EventSub[
    df$EventType == "Loss" &
      df$EventSub == "Other"
  ] <- "Other Loss"

  ##################################################
  ## summarize
  ##################################################
  plot_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::count(tumor_group, EventType, EventSub)

  ##################################################
  ## manual dodge positions
  ##################################################
  tumor_levels <- levels(df$tumor_group)
  plot_df$tumor_group <- factor(plot_df$tumor_group, levels = tumor_levels)
  plot_df$x_base <- as.numeric(plot_df$tumor_group)
  plot_df$x_pos <- ifelse(
    plot_df$EventType == "Gain",
    plot_df$x_base - 0.22,
    plot_df$x_base + 0.22
  )

  ##################################################
  ## plotting
  ##################################################
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = n, fill = EventSub)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.38, position = "stack") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(tumor_levels),
      labels = tumor_levels
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "1q Gain"    = "#B00020",
        "Other Gain" = "#F4A3A3",
        "9p Loss"    = "#0B3D91",
        "Other Loss" = "#AFC0F0"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab("") +
    ylim(ylim_use) +
    ylab(ylab_use) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18),
      legend.position = legend_pos,
      legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

  return(p)
}

##################################################
## immune cold
##################################################
arm_hit_cold  <- arm_hit[arm_hit$hit_group == "cold", ]
cyto_hit_cold <- cyto_hit[cyto_hit$hit_group == "cold", ]

##################################################
## arm-level cold
##################################################
sp2_1a_arm <- MakeSpecialBarplot(
  df = arm_hit_cold,
  arm_col = "Arm",
  special_gain = "Arm1q",
  special_loss = "Arm9p",
  title = "Immune Cold SCNA events (Arm-Level) p.adj < 0.2",
  ylim_use = arm_limit_y,
  ylab_use = "Number of Arm SCNAs"
)

##################################################
## cytoband-level cold
##################################################
sp2_1a_cyto <- MakeSpecialBarplot(
  df = cyto_hit_cold,
  arm_col = "ChrArm",
  special_gain = "1q",
  special_loss = "9p",
  title = "Immune Cold SCNA events (Cytoband-Level) p.adj < 0.2",
  ylim_use = cyto_limit_y,
  ylab_use = "Number of Cytoband SCNAs"
)

##################################################
## immune hot
##################################################
arm_hit_hot  <- arm_hit[arm_hit$hit_group == "hot", ]
cyto_hit_hot <- cyto_hit[cyto_hit$hit_group == "hot", ]

##################################################
## arm-level hot
##################################################
sp2_1b_arm <- MakeSpecialBarplot(
  df = arm_hit_hot,
  arm_col = "Arm",
  special_gain = "Arm1q",
  special_loss = "Arm9p",
  title = "Immune Hot SCNA events (Arm-Level) p.adj < 0.2",
  ylim_use = arm_limit_y,
  ylab_use = "Number of Arm SCNAs"
)

##################################################
## cytoband-level hot
##################################################
sp2_1b_cyto <- MakeSpecialBarplot(
  df = cyto_hit_hot,
  arm_col = "ChrArm",
  special_gain = "1q",
  special_loss = "9p",
  title = "Immune Hot SCNA events (Cytoband-Level) p.adj < 0.2",
  ylim_use = cyto_limit_y,
  ylab_use = "Number of Cytoband SCNAs"
)

##################################################
## combine panels
##################################################
sp2_1a <- wrap_elements(sp2_1a_arm + sp2_1a_cyto)
sp2_1b <- wrap_elements(sp2_1b_arm + sp2_1b_cyto)
sp2_1  <- sp2_1a / sp2_1b

##################################################
## save pdf
##################################################
# pdf("/Users/ze/Desktop/Ze_figure_github/figure2/sf2.1.pdf", height = 12, width = 20)
print(sp2_1)
# dev.off()
```
